latestVersion.changelog:
x402-direct 1.0.0

- Initial release of the x402.direct service directory API integration.
- Enables discovery and search of x402-enabled, crypto-payable API services for agents.
- Supports search (paid), browsing/filtering (free), detailed service lookups (free), and ecosystem stats (free).
- Provides trust scoring and categorization for services (AI, weather, data, language, and more).
- Includes guides for payment flow, trust score usage, and filtering options.
